76740.subject: ✨ July Journal: Electric Mobility, Innovation & Results
76740.body:
THE NEWSLETTER 

Автор: Volkswagen Group


Автор: Volkswagen Group

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/july-journal-electric-mobility-innovation-results-volkswagen-group-fka1e?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3Bqxl5frkgRLSbYCMMxcHFoQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=27PfDIE_i84Io1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~ms8nsq6f~dd-null-null&eid=fz96fz-ms8nsq6f-dd
  
Welcome to our July newsletter! This month, we take a look at the latest developments across the Volkswagen Group, from electric mobility and software innovation to future technologies and business results. From the world premiere of the Volkswagen ID. Cross, completing the Electric Urban Car Family, to new software capabilities powering our latest electric vehicles, July demonstrates how the Group is making advanced mobility accessible to more customers. At the same time, progress in autonomous driving, sustainable manufacturing and our battery ecosystem showcases the breadth of innovation across the Group. We also share updates on our latest delivery figures and half-year results. 🔍 Explore the 8️⃣ highlights that shaped this month: 🎉 1. World Premiere: ID. Cross The new Volkswagen ID. Cross celebrates its world premiere, completing the Electric Urban Car Family. 🗨️ Oliver Blume, CEO Volkswagen Group: "Four models, three brands, one platform: with the ID. Polo, the CUPRA Raval, the Škoda Epiq and the ID. Cross, Volkswagen Group is bringing individuality, quality and advanced technology to affordable electric mobility - without compromise." The strong customer response already shows the appeal of this concept: more than 54,000 orders have been received for the Electric Urban Car Family before all four models have even reached customers. 💻 2. Software Facts across the Electric Urban Car Family The Volkswagen Group's Electric Urban Car Family combines affordable electric mobility with a new software generation. Across models such as the CUPRA Raval, Volkswagen ID. Polo, Škoda Auto Epiq, and the Volkswagen ID. Cross, drivers benefit from features like Digital Key, next-generation Travel Assist, Android-based infotainment, connected vehicle services, and unique digital experiences tailored to everyday mobility. 🚗 3. Gen.Urban - Driving Experience in Urban Areas Volkswagen Group Innovation's self-driving research vehicle Gen.Urban has been collecting insights into future shared mobility in real-world traffic since the end of 2025. The project explores how passengers experience autonomous driving, which digital features best support work, entertainment, and relaxation and how-vehicle-passenger interaction should be designed. 🎨 4. Bentley's Dream Factory reaches new milestone With the opening of its new state-of-the-art Paint
